justifications.fit: _review_worker_launched (recovery.py:1474) reads the run's worker record through the existing _worker_record (recovery.py:5443) and follows the module's _review_* naming and fail-safe docstring style; only a two-line worker-record test is duplicated with _review_attempt_withdrawn_before_launch (recovery.py:1489).
justifications.goal_fidelity: the running half of the plan's review rule is implemented at recovery.py:1450 and joined to the carry-forward rule at recovery.py:1859, and the three done_when cases pass.
